(in rhet.) passion, emotion (2 kinds of Bhāvas are enumerated, the स्थायिन् or primary, and व्यभिचारिन् or subordinate; the former are 8 or 9 according as the Rasas or sentiments are taken to be 8 or 9; the latter 33 or 34), Kāv.; Sāh.; Pratāp. &c.

purport, meaning, sense (इति भावः, ‘such is the sense’ = इत्य् अर्थः or इत्य् अभिप्रायः, constantly used by commentators at the end of their explanations)
love, affection, attachment (भावं-√ कृ, with loc., to feel an affection for), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
the seat of the feelings or affections, heart, soul, mind (परितुष्टेन भावेन, with a pleased mind), ŚvetUp.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
that which is or exists, thing or substance, being or living creature (सर्व-भावाः, all earthly objects; भावाः स्थावर-जङ्गमाः, plants and animals), MuṇḍUp.; MBh. &c.
